LESSON: ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Oral Expression, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: how they plan for activities during the week with peers, Why is correct pronunciation important in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio on moments of the day and repeat the words (早上、上 午、下午、晚上),

2. take turns looking at a clock face and telling each other the time indicated,

3. play a charades game on verbs related to activities they undertake at home(起 床、睡觉、洗衣服、打 扫、打水、做饭、吃早、 午、晚饭、做作业、玩 儿、洗澡),

4. listen to an audio recording on routine/schedules about time at home and answer the related questions,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio on moments of the day and repeat the words (早上、上 午、下午、晚上),
2. take turns looking at a clock face and telling each other the time indicated,
3. play a charades game on verbs related to activities they undertake at home(起 床、睡觉、洗衣服、打 扫、打水、做饭、吃早、 午、晚饭、做作业、玩 儿、洗澡),
4. listen to an audio recording on routine/schedules about time at home and answer the related questions,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the learner interacts with digital technology to accomplish own tasks when they create schedules for their

weekend plans.

• Self-efficacy: the learner develops self-awareness skills as they outline their plan of activities for the weekend.

Values:
Integrity: self-discipline is developed when the learner plans how they will spend their time during the weekend.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Time management skills are enhanced as the learner creates a schedule of activities they will do during the weekend and present

in class.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

• The learner relates the knowledge of time management to Social Studies.

• The learner can relate their learning to Mathematics on the concept of telling or reading time.
